_comment: Fixed structural query bank for the Case Content Retrieval API. The two sentinels __A_DESCRIPTION__ and __B_DESCRIPTION__ are replaced at run time by the case's A_description / B_description so we fetch segments about each party. These queries mirror the canonical section structure of a Vietnamese first-instance civil judgment (đơn khởi kiện -> bị đơn trình bày -> người liên quan -> chứng cứ -> định giá -> phiên tòa -> tranh luận -> ý kiến VKS), maximising distinct-segment coverage per API call.
